d:
A major train derailment took place near Digaru railway station, close to Guwahati in Assam, on November 11. The engine and five coaches of the Kolkata-Sairang Express derailed around 6:54 am. The Northeast Frontier Railway said all passengers were safe and no injuries were reported. Meanwhile, an unverified video purportedly from the locomotive cabin has surfaced, in which the loco pilot can allegedly be heard saying that the red signal and emergency system were not working. Railways has not officially verified the video.
